about: #50: the raid of the general at the foot of Trâu Sơn on a phone: a tap on the enemies and a press at once; Gióng rides the iron horse beside the road, away from the jar, the brazier, and the forge, and the three are on the screen.
allow: the button Tiếp is under the bottom of the screen

steps.print: (() => { const s = tre.activeVillage.state(); const e = s.entities.find((x) => x.id === 'encounter:boss'); const h = s.entities.find((x) => x.id === 'hero'); return { enc: e?.position, hidden: e?.hidden, hero: h.position, screen: tre.activeVillage.screenOfThing('encounter:boss') }; })()

(() => { const s = tre.activeVillage.state(); const g = s.entities.find((e) => e.id === 'companion:raid'); const h = s.entities.find((e) => e.id === 'steed:raid'); return { riding: g?.riding, steed: h?.look, at: g?.position, sources: s.entities.filter((e) => e.source).map((e) => [e.id, tre.activeVillage.screenOfThing(e.id)]) }; })()
